Payment of 9000 yuan to余1某 and阿某, etc. So this is kidnapping for the purpose of forced marriage? The crime is "拐卖妇女、儿童" (trafficking of women and children). Chinese criminal law: "拐卖妇女、儿童罪" (kidnapping and trafficking). Also possibly "强迫卖淫" not here. The act is kidnapping and selling as wife, i.e., trafficking. So charge: "拐卖妇女、儿童". Also maybe "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" not relevant. So single charge.

Thus output: [罪名]拐卖妇女、儿童<eoa>
